FAQ

Questions

Are these the final prices?

They are starting prices. Your quote depends on video length, footage and volume. Ask the assistant for an instant estimate, or DM @congenmedia.

Do I get the project files?

Yes, After Effects and Photoshop files can be added to any plan.

Can I change plans?

Yes, move up or down at the start of any month.

Do you work with clients outside Pakistan?

Yes, we work with brands and creators worldwide.
